body:
Violet Rift transforms your PvP experience with a sleek, high-contrast purple texture overhaul built for speed and clarity. Every sword, tool, and weapon gets a custom violet-tinted redesign so hits, crits, and combos are easier to track mid-fight, while armor and UI elements stay clean and uncluttered. Designed with competitive and casual PvP servers in mind, Violet Rift keeps performance light and textures crisp at low resolutions, making it a great pick for bed wars, skywars, or any fast-paced combat gamemode.
Currently supports Minecraft 1.21.6 through 1.21.11, with more version updates planned as new releases roll out.
Minimum system requirements to run smoothly:

Processor: 1 GHz
Memory: 1024 MB RAM
Graphics: 128 MB video card with OpenGL support

Simple to install, easy on the eyes, and built to give your gameplay a distinct edge.
Found a bug, glitch, or have a suggestion? Join the support Discord: https://discord.gg/UE8nwGbYwt
